title.en: Read from a file, write to a file

hints.tr: Aynı satırda iki yönlendirme olabilir: `komut < girdi > çıktı`.
hints.en: One line can have two redirections: `command < input > output`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
sort < names.txt > sorted.txt
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
sort < names.txt > sorted.txt
```

label.tr: sorted.txt sıralı: ada, alan, grace, linus
label.en: sorted.txt is sorted: ada, alan, grace, linus
names.txt is unchanged and was read with <
